### MetricGraph
Random fields on metric graphs: Gaussian Whittle–Matérn fields, graph construction and inference for data on networks such as roads or rivers.
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=MetricGraph) · [Documentation](https://davidbolin.github.io/MetricGraph/)

### ngme2
Linear latent non-Gaussian models with flexible distributions, for spatial, temporal and longitudinal data.
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=ngme2) · [Documentation](https://davidbolin.github.io/ngme2/)

### SLOPE
Sorted L1 penalized estimation (SLOPE) for sparse regression.
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=SLOPE) · [Documentation](https://jolars.github.io/SLOPE/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/jolars/SLOPE)
